article.title: iPhone manufacturing in India gets a tariff boost
article.summary: As reported by Reuters , India continued its push to become a larger electronics manufacturing hub today by removing import duties on select parts used in smartphones and other devices. Here are the details.
article.title_zh: 印度 iPhone 製造獲得關稅提升
article.summary_zh: 據路透社報導，印度今日透過移除智慧型手機及其他設備零件的進口稅，繼續推進成為更大電子製造樞紐的目標。

article.title: UK still has Europe's worst 5G a year after VodafoneThree merger
article.summary: The merger between Vodafone and Three was supposed to improve 5G in the UK, but it sits at the bottom of Opensignal's latest ranking of network experience in Europe.
article.title_zh: 英國在 Vodafone Three 合併一年後仍為歐洲 5G 最差
article.summary_zh: Vodafone 和 Three 的合併原本應改善英國 5G，但在 Opensignal 最新的歐洲網絡體驗排名中位列最後。

article.title: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A to help enterprises build their own AI agents
article.summary: Founded in 2024, Prime Intellect’s goal is to give organizations capabilities to train their own agentic systems without relying on frontier AI labs.
article.title_zh: Prime Intellect 募資 1.3 億美元 Series A，幫助企業構建自有 AI 代理
article.summary_zh: 成立於 2024 年的 Prime Intellect 旨在使企業能夠在不依賴頂級 AI 實驗室的情況下訓練自有代理系統。

article.title: Google Photos is finally getting its bottom bar redesign on Android
article.summary: TL;DR The Google Photos app on Android is being updated with a new navigation button layout. The new bottom bar is visually smaller and persistent across different views in the Photos app. This version has been available on iOS since early 2026, but is new for Android users. Early this year, Google rolled out a nice little UI tweak for Google Photos . The app’s bottom navigation bar was redesigned in a February update, making it more compact and allowing more of your photos to show through. At the time, that update only hit the iOS version of Photos — but now, it’s rolling out broadly on Android, too. The redesigned bottom bar is now available for many users on Android, as spotted by 9to5Google . We’re seeing it on our own phones here at Android Authority, too.
article.title_zh: Google Photos 終於在 Android 上推出底部導航欄重新設計
article.summary_zh: Google Photos Android 應用程式更新了新的導航按鈕配置，新的底部欄視覺上更小且在應用程式的各個視圖中持續顯示。此版本已在 iOS 上推出，現已登陸 Android 用戶。

article.title: The Expansion Of LPDDR Into Edge AI Platforms
article.summary: As artificial intelligence continues its migration from centralized data centers to distributed systems, one reality is becoming unmistakable: the future of AI is increasingly defined at the edge. Whether embedded in smart cameras, industrial controllers, or next-generation vehicles, AI is no longer confined to racks of GPUs. It is operating in power-constrained, thermally limited, and space-restricted environments where system design priorities are fundamentally different. In this new landscape, memory has emerged as a first-order design constraint. And with that shift, LPDDR is rapidly expanding beyond its mobile roots to become a foundational technology for edge and automotive AI platforms. The underlying driver is simple but profound. article.title_zh: LPDDR 在邊緣 AI 平台中的擴展
article.summary_zh: 隨著人工智能從集中式數據中心遷移到分佈式系統，AI 的未來日益由邊緣定義，無論是嵌入智能相機、工業控制器還是下一代車輛。

article.title: A Startup That Builds AI Agents Used One to Raise $100 Million
article.summary: A startup that helps enterprises build AI agents proved the technology’s value in the most practical way possible: by deploying one during its own fundraising.
article.title_zh: 構建AI代理的新創用AI完成1億美元融資
article.summary_zh: 幫助企業構建AI代理的新創以最實際的方式證明了該技術的價值：在自身融資中部署AI代理。

article.title: Meta just launched a new AI generator, Muse Image, and users are already pushing back over use of their photos
article.summary: The new image-generating model has numerous use cases, including advertising and decorating, and creator-based opportunities.
article.title_zh: Meta 推出新 AI 圖像生成器 Muse Image，用戶已開始反對使用他們的照片
article.summary_zh: 這個新圖像生成模型具有多種用途，包括廣告和裝飾，以及基於創作者的機會。

article.title: OpenAI just upgraded ChatGPT voice mode in a major way, including CarPlay
article.summary: A shiny new model isn’t the only upgrade coming to ChatGPT this week. In addition to GPT-5.6’s release tomorrow, OpenAI is announcing an all-new ChatGPT voice mode experience as well. Because ChatGPT works with CarPlay, today’s release also is a major upgrade to the CarPlay voice mode experience as well.
article.title_zh: OpenAI 以重大方式升級 ChatGPT 語音模式，包括 CarPlay 支援
article.summary_zh: 除了 GPT-5.6 即將發布外，OpenAI 還推出全新的 ChatGPT 語音模式體驗，為 CarPlay 帶來重大升級。

article.title: AI Chip Startup Raises Funds at $11B Valuation
article.summary: Bloomberg's Ryan Gould joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Chip startup SambaNova has raised $1 billion at an $11 billion valuation, underscoring investors’ conviction in rising demand for infrastructure tied to artificial intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)
article.title_zh: AI 晶片新創公司以 110 億美元估值融資
article.summary_zh: 晶片新創公司 SambaNova 以 110 億美元估值融資 10 億美元，凸顯投資者對人工智慧基礎設施需求持續增長的信心。

article.title: Report: Apple interested in startup that runs giant AI models on iPhone without servers
article.summary: The Information reports that Apple may be interested in PrismML’s technology. The firm is focused on shrinking AI models that generally require servers to function, offering on-device functionality with comparable intelligence.
article.title_zh: 報告：Apple 對於在 iPhone 上運行大型 AI 模型而不需要伺服器的新創公司感興趣
article.summary_zh: The Information 報導 Apple 可能對 PrismML 技術感興趣，該公司致力於縮減通常需要伺服器才能運行的 AI 模型，提供具有可比智能的設備端功能。

article.title: One of the first Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 flagship phones could be a spec monster
article.summary: TL;DR The Xiaomi 18 Pro is leaked to feature a 2nm flagship SoC (likely the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 or Gen 6 Pro) and a massive ~7,000mAh battery with 100W wired charging, and wireless charging. It could also pack in two 200MP cameras: an ultra-large primary sensor and a large-sensor telephoto macro. camera. Due to an industry-wide RAM crisis, a noticeable price bump is expected, but these spec bumps could help lessen the sticker shock. Qualcomm is expected to launch the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series at its annual Snapdragon Summit event in Hawaii on September 24, 2026. With this new SoC series, we’re expecting a wave of new Android flagships to follow, and one of the first could be the Xiaomi 18 Pro . article.title_zh: 首批 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 旗艦手機之一可能成為規格怪獸
article.summary_zh: Xiaomi 18 Pro 據洩露將搭載 2nm 旗艦 SoC 和約 7,000mAh 大電池、100W 有線充電及無線充電，並配備兩顆 200MP 相機。

article.title: Google Search hit an all-time usage record yesterday
article.summary: At the end of the Argentina vs Egypt match during the World Cup yesterday, Google Search usage apparently hit a new all-time record high.
article.title_zh: Google 搜尋昨日創下歷史最高使用量紀錄
article.summary_zh: 在昨日世界盃阿根廷對埃及的比賽結束時，Google 搜尋使用量創下新的歷史紀錄高點。
